    Question chart

    How the lost-item reading is calculated

    This simplified Nashta Prasna reading adapts Prasna Marga II, chapter 29, verses 50–53. The ruler of the second sign from the Moon guides the place clue. For the taking pattern, the app compares that planet with the third- and sixth-house rulers using aspects within 6°. It checks the first and eleventh houses for recovery signs.

    The last confirmed sighting takes priority in the search. The chart can suggest where to look. Evidence is what can establish whether someone took it.

    How the answer is calculated

    Your selected question type determines which houses to check. This simplified reading uses aspects within 6° and compares actual planetary motion to tell an approaching aspect from one that is moving away. It draws on Prasna Tantra.
